efx_envelope.runs: track 0 only (y:$124==0), accumulator Y:$4FF = page+$FF of track 0
efx_envelope.destination: T5 ramp mod[k] = (env*DWID)^2 -> master mix T6

arming.tables: T1 = x:(r0+$144BC9), T2 = x:(r0+$144C49), pair of 8192-word tables
arming.gate: T1[LPQ] * (TEMPO*$791FD0*32) >= $4000; TEMPO cell = P+$23 (host writes BPM<<16)
arming.target: L:P+$CD = P2A * T2[LPQ] * $21D10 (48-bit); P+$2A = host cell

retune_glide.gate: X:(P+$D0) >= $3FF0; cell host-coupled (rewritten from global L:$FC at $09FA)
retune_glide.single_frame_check: L=0, T=0x40_000000 -> new L low half = $19999A = exactly 0.1 in 1.23 frac (OK)
retune_glide.read_position_slew: global L:$FC slews toward (write - length) clamped to +/-4 words per frame ($09AB-$09C9)

ring.taps: 17 taps L:$90-$A0 (X=integer, Y=frac), integration step Q=1/length (iter 22)
ring.echo_bus: T6: 16 words echo[k] -> X:(X:$2C9)+ (X:$300+ in harness); host mixes

knob_findings.DTIM_P1B: DSP: only EFX-envelope release curve index. Delay length comes from host cell P+$2A (ColdFire computes from DTIM/DBAS/TEMPO) — no DTIM->length math in DSP firmware
knob_findings.DSND_P1C: ZERO reads in DSP kernel -> send gain applied by ColdFire mixer
knob_findings.DFB_P1D: ZERO reads in DSP kernel -> feedback is host-side
knob_findings.DBAS_P1E: ZERO reads in DSP kernel -> base delay is host-side
